description: This Java source file contains an integration test class 'OAuth2AuthenticationTest' for testing OAuth2 authentication flows in the Fineract project. It utilizes REST-assured for HTTP requests, Selenium WebDriver for simulating user login, and JUnit 5 for test definitions. The class sets up REST API specifications, performs OAuth2 login flow, and tests access to protected endpoints, including fetching user details with an OAuth2 token.

classes.name: OAuth2AuthenticationTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for validating OAuth2 login flow, endpoint accessibility, and user detail retrieval within the Fineract system.

methods.description: Verifies that protected API endpoints return 401 Unauthorized when accessed without proper authentication.
